pulse.text: **Kalshi came back online after three sweeps of rate limits — and it repriced Grok 4.6 hard.** The Aug 15 leg dropped to **74%** from the 86% we had been carrying, and the Aug 13 leg collapsed to **18%** from a prior 77%, with still no model card, API identifier or xAI post a week after Musk said "next week." Google's clock slipped again too: Kalshi marks Gemini 3.5 Pro at **41% by Aug 31**, down from 50%, and just 8% by Aug 16, while Polymarket's Aug 31 leg logged a seventh straight markdown to 36% — an unconfirmed Aug 12 rumor is circulating and the market plainly does not believe it. **Nothing shipped this sweep**: Claude Opus 5 still leads at **AA-Index 63** over Fable 5 at 62 and GPT-5.6 Sol at 61, and Anthropic gave back its September pop, easing to 79.5% from 82% while the August contract held at 94.5% on $1.48M. OpenAI drifted the other way — Kalshi's Astra-before-Oct-1 leg jumped to **81%** from 75% and GPT-6-before-Sep-1 to 25% from 17%, even as Polymarket cut GPT-6's Dec 31 leg to 84.5% from 87%. Watch Aug 13: if Grok 4.6 misses that window, xAI's monthly-foundation-model claim takes its first public dent.
